stem.text: Which description of Kirchhoff’s first law is correct?

A.text: It considers the currents at a junction in a circuit and is a consequence of the conservation of charge.

B.text: It considers the currents at a junction in a circuit and is a consequence of the conservation of energy.

C.text: It considers the electromotive forces and potential differences in a circuit loop and is a consequence of the conservation of charge.

D.text: It considers the electromotive forces and potential differences in a circuit loop and is a consequence of the conservation of energy.
